title: Leveraging Quantum Measurement Randomness for Shot-Efficient Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.41721v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In quantum computing, the readout always carries finite-shot sampling noise. Suppressing this noise through repeated measurements raises the cost of a quantum neural network (QNN). Meanwhile, a stochastic diffusion sampler deliberately adds randomness at each reverse (generation) step. This paper turns the measurement noise from a liability into a resource. Specifically, we use the noise quantum measurement produces anyway to replace part of the noise the sampler would otherwise inject. We characterize the measurement error as multinomial sampling noise propagated through a trainable linear readout. To connect the circuit's Born probabilities to the denoising task, we further formulate the diffusion process on a bounded zero-sum hyperplane mapped to the probability simplex. Therefore, we can employ a compensation noise to match the mean and covariance of the shot-noise-free linear update under some minimum shot conditions. Solving this

translated_title: 利用量子测量随机性实现省测量次数的高效扩散模型
translated_abstract: 在量子计算中，读取过程总是带有有限次测量的采样噪声。通过重复测量来抑制这种噪声会显著增加量子神经网络（QNN）的成本。与此同时，随机扩散采样器会在每个逆向（生成）步骤中刻意注入随机性。本文将测量噪声从一种负担转化为一种资源。具体而言，我们利用量子测量本身必然产生的噪声来替代采样器原本需要注入的部分噪声。我们将测量误差刻画为经过可训练线性读出层传播的多项式采样噪声。为了将量子线路的玻恩概率与去噪任务联系起来，我们进一步在映射到概率单纯形的有界零和超平面上构建扩散过程。因此，在满足一定最小测量次数条件下，我们可以引入补偿噪声，使其均值和协方差与无测量噪声的线性更新相匹配。
tldr: 本文提出将量子测量固有的有限次测量噪声转化为扩散采样器的随机性来源，用以替代采样器原本需要注入的部分噪声，从而大幅降低量子神经网络的测量成本，实现测量高效的量子扩散模型。
en_tdlr: This paper turns quantum measurement shot noise from a liability into a resource, using the inherent randomness of quantum readout to replace part of the noise injected by diffusion samplers, thereby enabling shot-efficient quantum diffusion models with significantly reduced measurement costs.
